cases.name: Melissa Annette DeLisle Spillers
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a loving mother, doting Nana, and a best friend to many, most of all, to her sister, and to her daughters. Many were drawn to her genuine and warm nature. Melissa had a gentle spirit and always put the needs others before her own. It was often joked she was a friend to the friendless. But of all the roles Melissa had in life, the one most important to know was she was a Christian."
